title: $\mu^2$-Bench: A Multilingual Machine Unlearning Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2609.20945v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Undesired information such as harmful content and private data propagates through Multilingual Large Language Models (LLMs) via direct training and indirect cross-linguistic spread. Multilingual Machine Unlearning (MMU) aims to remove such information, yet its evaluation remains underexplored, leaving unclear whether unlearning truly eliminates target knowledge across all languages. To bridge this gap, we introduce $\mu^2$-Bench, an MMU benchmark that simulates the full pipeline of memorization, unlearning, and evaluation across diverse languages. It 1) spans a broad set of languages, 2) evaluates on both training and hold-out languages, and 3) assesses knowledge as dispersed across multiple languages. We show that successful MMU requires methods that reflect multilingual characteristics, and conduct analysis to provide deeper insights into MMU.

translated_abstract: 诸如有害内容和隐私数据等不良信息会通过直接训练和间接的跨语言传播在多语言大语言模型（LLMs）中扩散。多语言机器遗忘（MMU）旨在移除这类信息，然而其评估仍未得到充分探索，导致遗忘是否真正在所有语言中消除了目标知识尚不清楚。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了 $\mu^2$-Bench，这是一个 MMU 基准，模拟了跨多种语言的记忆、遗忘和评估的完整流程。它：1）涵盖广泛的语言集合；2）在训练语言和保留语言上都进行评估；3）将知识视为分散在多种语言中进行评估。我们表明，成功的 MMU 需要能够反映多语言特性的方法，并进行了分析以提供对 MMU 的更深入见解。
tldr: 提出了多语言机器遗忘基准 $\mu^2$-Bench，通过模拟记忆-遗忘-评估的完整流程，揭示成功的多语言遗忘需要反映多语言特性的方法。
en_tdlr: We introduce $\mu^2$-Bench, a multilingual machine unlearning benchmark simulating the full memorization-unlearning-evaluation pipeline across languages, showing that successful MMU requires methods reflecting multilingual characteristics.
